about: I'm Tania Aisen, a designer based in Spain. I work on brand identity, websites and interfaces, from the first sketch to a live product.
Before design I spent more than ten years in finance. That helps me design with the business side in mind: numbers, processes and what a client needs to earn.
studio.format: Remote, with clients and teams in different countries. Full-time roles and project work. Languages: English, Spanish, Russian.
